items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-21
items.q: The first man that gave me the credit was Emil Bigard... he heard me. And he said I was a better drummer.

ctx.x: In other words, in other words, I took his own stuff. Well, I didn't say my own stuff, but the band said it. The first man that gave me the credit was Emil Bigard. Oh, yeah. That man, you're poor race, come along, he heard me. And he said I was a better drummer. Oh, yeah. So, then we come back, they kept bucking against each other out in the street, after we went with me. So, I left the punch band, went with the tuxedo band.
